parameters.query:
update public.contacts
set contact_intent = $1,
    contact_intent_classified_notes = $2
where id = $3
  and contact_intent_is_manual = false
  and interaction_notes = $4
returning id, contact_intent;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.data.contactIntent, $('Claim Contacts Needing Intent').item.json.interaction_notes, $('Claim Contacts Needing Intent').item.json.id, $('Claim Contacts Needing Intent').item.json.interaction_notes ] }}

parameters.content:
## pipeline-contact-intent
The n8n replacement for local-agent/agent.mjs intentLoop -- Stage 1 prove-the-pattern pipeline. Simplest skill (pure text, 3-value output), narrow optimistic-concurrency write, low consequence if wrong.

claim_contacts_needing_intent(5) is a plain STABLE select, not a row-locking claim like claim_pending_contacts -- concurrency safety comes entirely from Write Contact Intent optimistic WHERE (contact_intent_is_manual=false AND interaction_notes=snapshot). Two overlapping ticks picking the same row just means one wasted LLM call, never data corruption.

20s Schedule Trigger matches intentLoop own poll interval exactly -- no behavior change from today, just a different caller.

Classify Contact Intent runs mode=each (one call per claimed row, direct analog of the original small worker pool, sequential here rather than concurrency=2 in this first build).

Write Contact Intent references the ORIGINAL claim row's id/interaction_notes via the Claim Contacts Needing Intent node's own item, not the immediate predecessor json (which by this point holds sub-classify-contact-intent's success/data shape) -- per the SDK's guidance on reading further-upstream data after an Execute Workflow call.

A comma-joined queryReplacement string breaks the moment interaction_notes contains a comma, which free-text rep notes and voice-memo transcripts routinely do -- a single expression that evaluates to a real array sidesteps string splitting entirely.

On failure (success=false: a validation failure, an API error, or a tripped circuit breaker), the false branch does nothing -- item dropped, no write, row stays exactly as claim_contacts_needing_intent will see it again next tick. Nothing here retries or backs off explicitly, because this RPC has no attempt-count/cooldown state at all -- same as intentLoop today.

NOT DONE IN THIS PASS, BY DESIGN: no credentials get real values, this workflow is not activated, and it is not run side-by-side against production data yet.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 1). The two Postgres nodes have no credential attached yet -- see n8n/README.md.
